title: Vgate iCar Pro 2S (BLE)
notes: SRS 2.1. Service 0x18F0 echoes commands without executing them and must not be used. ATSP6 fixes 11-bit 500 kbaud CAN for the reference car; discovery will replace it with protocol detection for other vehicles. The init script ends with the polling timeout (ATST32, 200 ms); the probe lengthens it to ATST64 (400 ms) for the first contact with a car that may be slow to wake up, and the poll script puts it back. ATL0, ATS0, ATAT1 and ATST are tolerated if an adapter does not know them; ATE0, ATH1 and ATSP are not.
